en.headline: Hong Kong Green Week opens today with five days of sustainability forums
en.dek: The third edition of the HKMA-coordinated programme runs from 7 to 11 September under the theme Future-proofing Sustainable Growth, starting with a full-day green-finance forum in Wan Chai.
body: Hong Kong Green Week 2026 opens today and runs through Friday, the third edition of the city’s annual sustainability gathering coordinated by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority.

The official programme is themed “Future-proofing Sustainable Growth” and is organised around six topics: inclusive transition, climate adaptation and resilience, green technology, green trade and supply-chain resilience, nature and biodiversity conservation, and investing for social impact. Organisers split the week into a main programme of larger conferences and a set of satellite roundtables and workshops hosted by partner institutions.

Monday’s listed main event is the Hong Kong Green Finance Association’s Greater Bay Area forum at the Hopewell Hotel on Kennedy Road in Wan Chai, scheduled from 9am to 5.30pm and described as open to the public and to media, with a hybrid option. Details of later sessions, including a BloombergNEF green-tech dialogue on Tuesday, are posted on the event website.

The Monetary Authority said last year’s Green Week involved more than 40 events hosted by 65 institutions and drew more than 14,500 participants from over 75 jurisdictions. Programme listings and registration links are on the official Green Week site.

zh.headline: 第三屆香港綠色周今日展開 一連五日討論可持續發展
zh.dek: 由金管局統籌的香港綠色周今日至周五舉行，主題為「賦能未來・共築可持續發展」，周一主場是灣仔的綠色金融論壇。
body: 第三屆香港綠色周今日開幕，活動由今日起至周五，由香港金融管理局統籌。
官方主題為「賦能未來・共築可持續發展」，圍繞六個範疇：具包容性的轉型、氣候適應與韌性、綠色科技、綠色貿易與供應鏈韌性、自然與生物多樣性保育，以及具社會影響力的投資。活動分為大型會議為主的主題節目，以及由合作機構舉辦的圓桌、工作坊等周邊活動。
周一列出的主題活動是香港綠色金融協會大灣區論壇，於灣仔堅尼地道合和酒店舉行，時間為上午九時至下午五時半，主辦方標明公開予公眾及傳媒，並設線上參與。其後數日節目包括周二的BloombergNEF綠色科技對話，詳情載於活動網站。
金管局較早前表示，去年綠色周由65家機構舉辦逾40項活動，吸引來自75個以上司法管轄區超過14,500名參加者。日程及報名資料見官方綠色周網站。
